name: distdb
description: Deterministic, tick-based model of a small replicated, partitioned key-value store for teaching distributed databases. Single-leader replication (async, semi-sync, majority or sync acknowledgements, replication lag, failover by an external monitor, primary lease, split brain) and leaderless quorums (N/R/W, strict or sloppy, hinted handoff, read repair, Merkle anti-entropy, tombstones, last-write-wins or sibling versions). Messages travel with latency and are dropped by crashes and network partitions. A history checker labels every read (read-your-writes, monotonic reads, causal, real-time staleness) and checks linearizability. Also: key placement (range, hash, consistent hashing with virtual nodes) and a capacity model.
limits: At most 5 nodes, 4 clients, 8 keys and 40 ticks; one tick is one network hop (latency 1 within a region, the WAN setting across regions).
The failure detector is perfect for reachability decisions; failover is an external monitor on the majority side, not a consensus election (lesson 3).
Leaderless reads ask the R closest replicas (the coordinator first), or every replica when async read repair is on; replicas of every key are the first N nodes.
Conflict detection with version vectors is used as a black box; LWW compares (timestamp, node) where timestamp = tick + the node's clock skew.
Product profiles are named configurations of this engine that reproduce documented visible behaviour for these workloads, not product internals.

ddTrace.description: Per-tick trace rows (0..40) for a scenario index or id. overrides: {ack, replDelay, failover, lease, read, N, R, W, down, readRepair, sloppy, policy, wan, hints, ae, gcGrace, resolve, profile}; a negative value keeps the scenario's own setting. Bind with tableBindings.

ddCaption.description: Markdown caption: guidance, what happened at this tick, the linearizability verdict and the last read's label.

ddContext.description: Compact factual state for the AI tutor: nodes and their copies, clients, messages in flight, read labels, history check, metrics and history.

ddSetting.description: Slider readout; a negative value shows 'auto · <the scenario's own setting>'.

ddEff.description: Effective numeric setting: the value, or the scenario's own when negative.

ddGuarantee.description: Consistency scenario (row) × read mechanism (col) outcome code: 1 a guarantee broke, 2 unavailable, 4 fine.

ddQuorum.signature: ddQuorum(scenario, N, down, readRepair, row, col)
ddQuorum.description: Quorum matrix code for R = row+1, W = col+1: 0 lost write, 1 stale read, 2 failed requests, 4 fine, 5 not applicable.

ddProfileCell.description: Product profile (row) × comparison workload (col) outcome code.

ddPair.description: 1 while a message between nodes a and b is in flight or arrives this tick.

ddPairDir.description: 'forward' when this tick's traffic goes a → b, 'backward', 'both' or 'none' (for a system_dag connection's directionExpr).

ddPairColor.description: Resting colour of the a–b link: idle, cut by a partition (red) or an endpoint down.

ddShardLoad.description: Write load on shard i under a partitioning strategy.

ddRingMoved.description: Keys (of 48) that change owner under consistent hashing when the node count changes by change (−1, 0, +1).

ddCapAt.signature: ddCapAt(option, rate, writePct, extra, crashAt, t, field)
ddCapAt.description: Capacity model field at tick t (latR, latW, utilR, utilW, availR, availW, arrivals).
